root_cause.invariant: A native document with any parser-marked unread page must reach the source-recovery owner before whole-document summary preparation; the marker must never be cleared downstream.
root_cause.confirmed: PdfExtractParser marks each empty-native-text page requires_visual_processing=true and NO_NATIVE_TEXT. It sets document-wide NO_NATIVE_TEXT_IN_DOCUMENT only when every page is empty. parsed_document_requires_ocr checks only that document-wide warning. A mixed PDF therefore bypasses the OCR branch in desktop, while the whole-document writer correctly rejects its incomplete source. db.rs::prepare_ocr_handoff separately enforces that same whole-document-only warning, so changing routing alone would still hard-fail durable admission before transport.
root_cause.real_reproduction: preproduction-1:15 parsed pages, visual_pages=[15], document warnings=[], NativeText. Retained writer failure WHOLE_DOCUMENT_SOURCE_INVALID; visible page15 contains material text.
root_cause.introducing_commit: ad747378bed5f359022f11a3a91a75850e16f2c2 introduced the whole-document-only OCR predicate. It was designed for fully scanned documents; that admission scope is insufficient for complete mixed-PDF source coverage.

behavioral_contract.eligibility: SourceType::NativeText AND at least one parsed page has requires_visual_processing=true. The parser-owned page marker is authoritative; do not re-extract or inspect text in the routing predicate.
non_eligible: SourceType::OcrText, even with a malformed visual marker: never recursively OCR a derived document.
No pages, including a spurious document warning: do not dispatch from missing source.
behavioral_contract.whole_pdf_recovery: Use the unchanged original PDF and the existing whole-document OCR request, retained handoff and derived OcrText child. Preserve the root, source hash, provider identity, page-count validation, retry/cancellation/recovery ownership and source provenance. No native/OCR per-page splice.
behavioral_contract.cost: Any unread native page routes the whole PDF, including a genuinely blank page because the parser does not distinguish blank from content lacking native text. This can add OCR cost and change extracted text on already-readable pages. The derived source must be independently checked before qualification; this contract grants no live OCR spend. In particular, with no OCR provider installed, a native PDF with an actually blank page will now fail with OCR_HANDOFF_FAILED instead of continuing natively. No capability to identify a known-blank page is claimed.
behavioral_contract.errors: Existing provider-unavailable, cap, malformed output and cancellation errors remain truthful; never fall back to an incomplete summary or reuse an unqualified replacement source.
behavioral_contract.first_pdf_after_offline_repair: Eligibility becomes true. Its original incomplete NativeText artifact must still fail the writer guard. A successful writer plan is not claimed until a separately approved real OCR result is complete, verified and frozen.
behavioral_contract.second_pdf: OCR eligibility remains false. Its source-layout/boundary blocker is retained and not repaired by this slice.
behavioral_contract.durable_admission: The store consumes the same ParsedDocument eligibility helper as routing. Keep Parsed state, root-document identity, document NativeText, source size equality, original byte/hash equality, supplied hash equality and provider-app id checks unchanged. Update the old whole-document-scan rejection wording to describe an exact admitted native source requiring OCR; no schema change.
